title: Question 1
question: Define the SI unit of length.
answer: The metre (m) is the SI unit of length.

title: Question 2
question: What is matter?
answer: Anything that has mass and occupies space is called matter.

title: Question 3
question: Name the three common states of matter.
answer: Solid, liquid and gas.

title: Question 4
question: What is diffusion?
answer: The intermixing of particles of two substances on their own is called diffusion.

title: Question 5
question: Define evaporation.
answer: The change of a liquid into vapour from its surface at a temperature below its boiling point.

title: Question 6
question: What is an atom?
answer: The smallest particle of an element that takes part in a chemical reaction.

title: Question 7
question: What is a molecule?
answer: A group of two or more atoms chemically bonded together.

title: Question 8
question: State the law of conservation of mass.
answer: Mass can neither be created nor destroyed in a chemical reaction.

title: Question 9
question: What are isotopes?
answer: Atoms of the same element having the same atomic number but different mass numbers.

title: Question 10
question: Name the three subatomic particles and their charges.
answer: Proton: +1; electron: −1; neutron: 0.

title: Question 11
question: What is a cell?
answer: The basic structural and functional unit of life.

title: Question 12
question: Who discovered the cell?
answer: Robert Hooke.

title: Question 13
question: What is the function of the cell membrane?
answer: It regulates the movement of substances into and out of the cell.

title: Question 14
question: Differentiate between plant and animal cells by one feature.
answer: Plant cells usually have a cell wall and chloroplasts; animal cells do not.

title: Question 15
question: What is a tissue?
answer: A group of similar cells performing a specific function.

title: Question 16
question: Define speed.
answer: Distance travelled per unit time.

title: Question 17
question: What is acceleration?
answer: The rate of change of velocity with time.

title: Question 18
question: State Newton’s first law of motion.
answer: An object remains at rest or in uniform straight-line motion unless acted upon by an unbalanced external force.

title: Question 19
question: What is the SI unit of force?
answer: Newton (N).

title: Question 20
question: What is the function of the ozone layer?
answer: It absorbs most of the Sun’s harmful ultraviolet radiation.
